audit_scope.description: This batch covers CL light client gossip and request-response protocols (Altair), EL difficulty bomb delay (EIP-3554), CL execution proof gossip/discovery P2P interface (EIP-8025), and EL/CL sparse blobpool with probabilistic sampling (EIP-8070 eth/71).

out_of_scope: Full mempool management beyond blob transactions

el_vectors.threat: Send malformed NewPooledTransactionHashes with invalid cell_mask, withhold blob cells selectively (data availability attack), false provider claims, send oversized GetCells requests for resource exhaustion
Exploit difficulty bomb miscalculation for consensus divergence, include blob transactions without full data availability

cl_vectors.threat: Flood stale light client updates, submit forged sync committee signatures, propagate invalid execution proofs, eclipse light clients

cl_vectors.entry_point: Light Client Request-Response (bootstrap, updates_by_range, finality, optimistic)
cl_vectors.threat: Serve false bootstrap data to light clients, withhold updates, serve stale finality data to partition light clients
Selectively withhold cells to prevent data availability, lie about provider status, fail noise column checks

misclassified_entities.reason: Duplicate of EXT-GOSSIP-PEER in light client gossip context. Both represent the same external entity (a P2P gossip peer sending light client updates).
This is a specific interaction mode (discv5 query) of a generic P2P peer, not a distinct external entity. Subsumed by the general peer node entity.

trusted_external_entities.name: CL Gossip Peer via P2P
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Unauthenticated P2P gossip peer. May publish stale updates, forged sync committee signatures, or invalid execution proofs. All gossip messages require slot freshness checks, propagation timing validation, BLS signature verification, and duplicate detection.

trusted_external_entities.name: Light Client via Request-Response
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: CL req/resp protocols (light_client_bootstrap, light_client_updates_by_range, light_client_finality_update, light_client_optimistic_update)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Unauthenticated P2P peer requesting light client data. May attempt resource exhaustion by requesting large ranges (bounded by MAX_REQUEST_LIGHT_CLIENT_UPDATES=128). Request parameters must be validated.

trusted_external_entities.name: P2P Peer via eth/71 (Sparse Blobpool)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: devp2p eth/71 protocol (NewPooledTransactionHashes 0x08, GetPooledTransactions 0x09, PooledTransactions 0x10, GetCells 0x12, Cells 0x13)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Unauthenticated P2P peer participating in sparse blobpool protocol. May send invalid cell_mask bitmaps, malformed messages, withhold blob cells selectively, or claim provider status without having full data. Cell data must be validated per EIP-7594.

trusted_external_entities.name: Blob Provider Peer via eth/71
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Peer claiming provider role (full blob data availability). May selectively withhold cells, fail noise column verification, or provide invalid cell data. Noise columns (C_extra=1) are used to detect misbehavior. Provider must return custody-aligned columns plus noise column.

trusted_external_entities.name: Peer via Execution Proof Gossip
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Unauthenticated peer sending execution proof gossip or requesting proofs by root. Gossip validation requires: payload previously seen check, first-proof-per-tuple uniqueness, active validator verification, BLS signature check, proof size within MAX_PROOF_SIZE, valid structure.

trusted_external_entities.name: Peer Requesting Execution Proofs
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Unauthenticated peer requesting execution proofs by block root. Response bounded by MAX_EXECUTION_PROOFS_PER_PAYLOAD (4). May attempt resource exhaustion via repeated requests.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Must validate: attested slot freshness (exceeds all previously forwarded or matches with supermajority >= 2/3), propagation timing from slot start, BLS aggregate sync committee signature. Stale or invalid updates must be dropped.
Must validate: attested header slot freshness, propagation timing, sync committee BLS signature, consistency with finality data. Invalid updates dropped.
Requested block root must be for a post-Altair finalized block. If data unavailable, respond with ResourceUnavailable error code 3. Must not serve unfinalized or pre-Altair data.
Count bounded by MAX_REQUEST_LIGHT_CLIENT_UPDATES (128). Start period and count must be validated. Only return updates for sync committee periods with available data.

cell_mask must be validated: nil when no type-3 transactions present, valid B_16 bitmap otherwise. Transaction hashes must be validated. Announcements trigger probabilistic role assignment (p=0.15 provider, p=0.85 sampler).

Cell data must be validated per EIP-7594. Noise column (C_extra=1) must be checked: if provider fails to return noise column, flag as misbehavior. Maximum C_req=8 columns per request. At least 2 distinct providers must be observed before sampling.

Full validation pipeline: (1) corresponding new_payload_request previously seen, (2) first proof for (root, type, prover_pubkey) tuple, (3) prover is active validator in current state, (4) valid BLS signature, (5) proof data non-empty and within MAX_PROOF_SIZE, (6) valid message structure.
Response bounded by MAX_EXECUTION_PROOFS_PER_PAYLOAD (4). Block root must reference a known block. Only return locally stored valid proofs.
